name: Abimelech
bio:
Abimelech is king of Gerar, appearing in the stories of both Abraham and, later, Isaac (Genesis 20; 26). While sojourning in Gerar, Abraham again claimed Sarah was his sister, and Abimelech sent for her; but God appeared to him in a dream, warning him that Sarah was a married woman. Abimelech had not yet come near her, and pleaded his innocence before God (Genesis 20:1-7).

God accepted Abimelech's plea, instructed him to restore Sarah, and had Abraham pray for his healing. Abimelech not only returned Sarah but gave sheep, servants, and silver as compensation, and made a covenant with Abraham, resolving a dispute over a well and establishing Beersheba as the place of their covenant (Genesis 21:22-34). Abimelech's story shows that even a foreign king was regarded by God as valuing justice and honesty, and that God was willing to protect those under His care from unwitting harm.
